OnSide · Master Project Plan

The 8-week build to five paying customers

One plan across four parallel tracks: migrate every system to a SOC 2-compliant cloud, build OnSide v1, run the SOC 2 audit, and convert a warm pipeline into five signed credit unions by December 31.

8 wksIntensive build + migration
~Sep 1Config freeze · window starts

The plan on one screen

Four tracks, run in parallel

The first eight weeks (mid-August to early October) are an intensive, parallel sprint. Three tracks build the compliant company and the product; the fourth turns it into revenue. Everything converges on the December 31 goal. The cloud build (Azure hosting, virtual desktops, and model inference) is underwritten by $100K+ in Microsoft for Startups credits, so the real cash burn is licenses, the audit, insurance, legal, and hires.

Track 1

Platform migration & cloud

Staff onto Azure Virtual Desktop, Dan and Adam on managed machines; Microsoft 365, GitHub Enterprise, Claude Team. Azure compute covered by $100K+ startup credits.

Track 2

SOC 2 readiness & audit

The signed 1-year audit ($12,500/yr): readiness sprint, control freeze, the Type II observation window, and the diligence data room.

Track 3

OnSide product buildout

The v1 five credit unions can buy, hardened from the 6-week walking-skeleton pilot on AFCU's real BSA/AML data.

Track 4

GTM, sales, legal & hiring

Demand is secured, a backlog of interested CUs is already lined up. This track converts that waiting pool into signed logos, plus contracts, insurance, and the build capacity to deliver. Rachel (CRO) already owns compliance. No acquisition needed.

Each gate is a shared, checkable moment. The two filled gates are the ones the whole plan pivots on: the September 1 config freeze that starts the audit clock, and the December 31 goal.

The critical path

One hard date holds the whole plan together

The September 1 freeze

Migrate and remediate in August, then freeze

A SOC 2 Type II report attests that controls operated over the entire observation window. So the platform migration and the readiness sprint must both finish, and the configuration must freeze, by roughly September 1. Miss it and the window cannot accrue enough runway for a report before year-end. This is the single most time-sensitive commitment in the program.

Config freeze → the Type II observation window can start (~Sep 1).
Pilot complete (Wk 6) → hardening to the multi-tenant v1 begins.
v1 + data room → first sales meetings open (diligence handled in days).
Type II report + references → the final closes through December.
From build to five customers

How the 8-week build closes by December 31

Demand is already secured, so the last quarter is about conversion and delivery, not finding buyers. By early October the product is multi-tenant, the audit window is running, and the diligence data room is ready to hand over at first contact, so a normally 9-to-18-month regulated sale compresses to under 90 days for a backlog that is already interested.

Oct

Conversion opens

First cohort drawn from the waiting backlog; v1 live; data room handed over at first contact. No lead-gen, the demand is already there.

Nov

Cohort converts

First-cohort opportunities into active diligence; proposals at Founding-5 pricing; first two customers signed and invoiced.

Mid-Dec

Type II issued

The observation window closes; the managed partner issues the SOC 2 Type II report into the data room.

Dec 31

Five signed

Five annual contracts signed with first invoice paid. Five referenceable logos that make Year 2 cheap.

OnSide is a working product name; a rename is in progress under trademark review. Cloud infrastructure (Azure hosting, Azure Virtual Desktop, Azure OpenAI) is covered by $100K+ in Microsoft for Startups credits; Microsoft 365 / E5 licenses and the SOC 2 audit are separate paid lines. All regulatory references are informational; institutions bear sole responsibility for verifying regulatory currency with their primary federal regulator. Vendor compliance status changes; verify each attestation against the vendor trust portal. Prepared August 2026 · LeapFI · Draft for team review.
